tinyik.description: Two-bone inverse kinematics and FABRIK with joint limits. Bend a little wooden giraffe in your browser, driven by either C++ or Rust.
tinyik.alt: A wooden giraffe with alternating neck beads and a flowered green base in the tinyik playground

tinyflock.description: A few simple rules and a sky full of birds. Play with the flock in your browser.
tinyflock.alt: A flock of animated gulls flying against the evening sky

images.label: Flock
images.alt: Animated gulls flying against the evening sky

images.label: Bird study
images.alt: Close-up of the articulated gull model and feathered wings

tinyshp.description: Load ESRI shapefiles, attributes and projections in one C++23 header. Explore the results on a map, globe or in 3D.
tinyshp.alt: Cambridge buildings visualized by height in the tinyshp testbed

tinysph.description: A fluid simulation library with CPU and GPU solvers, colliders, emitters and an interactive water sandbox.

tinyverlet.description: Particles and constraints for cloth, ropes and soft bodies, with collisions, wind and tearing. All in one header.

tinyeasings.description: Thirty easing curves in one dependency-free C++23 header, with compile-time evaluation and runtime selection.
tinyeasings.alt: Interactive easing demo plotting an easeOutBounce curve

deceptus_engine.title: Deceptus Engine
deceptus_engine.description: A C++23 and Lua platformer engine with deferred lighting, water, weather and Tiled levels. Desktop, browser and Switch homebrew builds.

dynablaster_revenge_sdl.title: Dynablaster Revenge · SDL

dynablaster_revenge.title: Dynablaster Revenge
